items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: Stafford — what’s Stafford’s last name, I’m going to forget, the trombone player — oh darn — that played with Clark. Anyway he sort of worked on getting the musicians there.

ctx.x: Am I correct that you were at his bedside near the end of his life?

Oh yeah. I was the party planner for his 90th and 94th birthday parties. And the 94th was just a few months before he passed away. And a bunch of the guys that had been on his big band, all of us came together and Stafford — what’s Stafford’s last name, I’m going to forget, the trombone player — oh darn — that played with Clark. Anyway he sort of worked on getting the musicians there. So we actually had enough, with adding some people, to get out Clark’s big band book and we actually set up in his living room and…
Let me ask you about high notes. You have a way of talking about high notes are not necessarily higher, they’re farther away?
